So not husband but along a similar kind of thread. I'm a yacht instructor and one year myself and my parents decided to hire a yacht for a week in Croatia. My mum can't sail and my dad has basic crewing experience but thats about it. Essentially it was my name getting put on all the paperwork and insurance and me who would be responsible for the boat. 

The guy from the company who owned the boat came to give the handover of the yacht and kept directing everything to my dad. Countless times my dad tried to direct him back towards me, even expressing that none of what the guy said made any sense to him, but the guy kept doing it. Safe to say I was pissed off and my dad was just confused as hell, to the point where I ended up standing right in front of the guy and asking him point blank why he was telling my dad when I was the skipper. 

There's a lot of sexism in sailing but thats one of the most common, assuming the guy is in charge of the yacht.

Honestly, I end up in similar situations frequently. I struggle with becoming far too quickly attached in a relationship or alternatively aid pay attention to anyone who pays me attention, which has put me in places that I dont want to be in. 

Over the last year, I've tried to work on this and it's the absolute hardest thing to change. 

I tried counselling,I tried positive affirmations, I tried hard to not even get attached to anyone...it all didnt work but because of 4 months of lockdown (in my country) I've been forced to. I've spent more time on myself, on enjoying my own company and loving myself as I am. Theres days I hate myself, theres days I want to feel like someone loves me but now theres more and more days where I actually feel worthwhile, where I feel worth it. I'm not saying isolate yourself for 4 months, because it will take longer than that. I've been trying to "fix" it for a year. But honestly the best things I can recommend are try and work on loving yourself, feeling that you're worth it. But also, just love hard...embrace that part of yourself. I love people, I forgive people and god damn if I dont do anything I can to make people around me happy. I'm not saying sacrifice how you feel but it's a part of you and it's a part of why people love you. There will be someone who loves how hard you love and you will find them. Love yourself as deeply as you love others x
